'''2014 Alderaan Regionals Adam K DS Imperial Occupation (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Adam K]] at [[2014 Alderaan Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V)]]
* '''Username:''' Plagueis
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
